How Lancellot Works

Pick your game

You can choose to play in lotteries from all over the world, with different winning amounts!

Create a group, or join one

You can create a group and invite your family, friends and co-workers, or join one and play with people from all over the world

Place your order

What happens now, you ask? Lancellot sends a courier to buy your ticket for you from an official lottery retailer.

See your ticket

We send a scan of your ticket to the app and an order confirmation to your email. Your paper ticket is safely stored in a fireproof safe.

Collect your winnings

Winnings under $1000 go straight to your Lancellot account. When you win big, we arrange to securely deliver your money to you. May you be so lucky

Increase Your Chances To Win

Currently, over 25% of all global lottery tickets are purchased by groups of 2 people or more. Lancellot provides a unique solution allowing people to buy lottery tickets as a group safely and securely.

Need A Little Help?

Is Lancellot legal?

100% yes, Lancellot is an online platform for purchasing online lottery tickets.
Working with state laws and regulations our services provide a transparent and straightforward distribution of the group winnings.

Where can I play Lancellot?

From anywhere and anytime! You just need to open your phone and go to Lancellot App and start playing!

How do I download and install the app?

Great question! As soon as we launch the application it will appear in the app store and Android store under the name “Lancellot”.

How is my ticket order fulfilled?

Lancellot couriers (Knight) purchase tickets for players and send them to Lancellot to secure winnings.
As soon as the ticket is purchased and scanned it is sent to your phone with the recipe indicating your share of the ticket and participating numbers.

Is Lancellot safe?

Yes! Lancellot provides you with a secure platform to order your tickets. For each order, you will receive an email with your receipt, and a notification when your tickets have been secured, and you can even see a photo of your physical tickets in the app.

What happens to the physical tickets?

Your physical tickets are securely stored in a locked vault that only our core team members have access to. For your records, you will be given a scan of your ticket, which you can view in the app, after it has been purchased.

How does Lancellot work?

Lancellot is a social network providing you the option to play with friends and increase your chances of winning.
Couriers purchase tickets for players and send them to Lancellot to secure winnings

As soon as the ticket is purchased and scanned it is sent to your phone with the recipe indicating your share of the ticket and participating numbers.

Does Lancellot decide who wins / control the drawings?

No. We offer a secure group buying platform so you can order state lottery tickets, but the game rules and draws are administered by the state lotteries and out of our control. We do not choose the winners in the lottery – you have the same chances of winning a Lancellot as in the store.

What happens if I win?

When you win the prize will be distributed in proportion to the share in the group between the ticket holders.

The money will be transferred directly to your personal account. You can play with it or withdraw the money via credit card or wire transfer.

When will the Lancellot app be available for Android?

Our team is currently developing the Android version and we aim to launch it soon. We don’t have an exact date yet but sign up here to get notified as soon as it’s available.
